messages.subject: HTML content
parts:
Hi,

I am working on a shiny app which will generate a plot using ggplot2 and export it to sag by using gridSVG. It is almost there but there is an issue I am struggling with. 

In the ui.R I got:

mainPanel(
....
        htmlOutput(outputId="svg.grid")
....
)

and in the server.R I got:

output$svg.grid <- renderText({
...
    svg <- generateGraphic(...)  
    paste(svg,sep="")  
  })

After running this app, I got an html file whose source includes  "<div id="svg.grid" class="shiny-html-output"></div>". 

How do I get the "<svg>...</svg>" content? I can see it when I inspect the DOM tree.

Cheers,
Chatai
